page.layout: One page: the green limp cover of the book, with a dark stamp or device in the centre (a blackened emblem, not printed text). No printed text blocks.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside of a green vellum or limp binding, not a printed page. There is no printed text, page number, running head or catchword. The dark central mark is a blind-stamped or inked device (it looks like a heraldic or printer's emblem, possibly a beast with a tail), and it is not legible as text. Wear, stains and paper patches on the cover and spine are damage only. Pages with the printed text will need to be sent separately to be transcribed.
